newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips touch session lows in late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips touch session lows in late trade.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks dipped to fresh session lows in late trading on Monday.
Traders attributed the softness to profit-taking and unwinding of positions from Friday's triple-witching options and futures expirations. Bonds were also soft.
The Dow was down about 100 points, or 1.2 percent, at 7696. Decliners held a 15-to-nine lead over gainers.
Tobacco stocks fell for a second session after Friday's announced liability settlement deal, with Dow component Philip Morris Cos Inc dipping 2-1/4 to 43-3/8.
The Nasdaq composite was off four at 1443.
